verdict.rationale: The Canada Revenue Agency is a government tax authority whose e-services are registration, filing, payment and EFILE transmission channels. It is not an AI agent or tool-using host, so plugging in MCP servers as a client is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any AI assistant that could consume MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
